## For data changes

- [ ] Each value comes from a publisher release; the topic README lists the release, date, link and sha256.
- [ ] Revised values keep the old value and the revision date in the README.
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes (it checks that every number in the copy is a published value).

## For code changes

- [ ] `pnpm check`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e` pass.
